items.q: Can I change my plan at any time?
items.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan from the dashboard at any time. Changes apply immediately.

items.q: What happens if I exceed the prediction limit?
items.a: Extra predictions are charged at $0.002 per prediction on Starter and Pro plans. Enterprise has unlimited predictions.

items.q: Is there a trial period for the Pro plan?
items.a: The Pro plan includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to get started.

items.q: How does in-browser model training work?
items.a: We use TensorFlow.js to train the neural network directly in the user's browser. Data never leaves the device.

items.q: Can I use the widget on multiple stores?
items.a: Each store needs its own API key. On the Pro plan you can have up to 3 models for 3 different stores.
